title: Meet Bitrig’s New Look
summary: A unified sidebar, a GPU-accelerated transcript, a native diff viewer, and new color themes.
body_markdown:
For my first computer science course, my professor had us install Eclipse, a cross-platform Java IDE. I fell in love with programming, but I always felt[a little gross](https://www.andrew.cmu.edu/course/15-CSAP/15-111/Eclipse%20Help/newclass.png) using Eclipse.


A great native app has the opposite effect. It leaves me energized and looking for excuses to use it more. That’s how this latest version of Bitrig makes me feel.


It didn’t happen overnight. Today’s new look is the culmination of months of rebuilding, refining, and optimizing.


Here’s what you’ll find:


-


**A unified sidebar.** Every project, workspace, and conversation now lives in the sidebar, so it’s easier to work across projects and keep an eye on which conversations need you. Hover over any conversation to see its project and branch, what the agent is doing, and where its pull requests stand.


-


**A GPU-accelerated transcript.** Our new Metal transcript scrolls and resizes without ever dropping a frame. Replies stream in letter by letter, each one sharpening into focus. Runs of commands and edits collapse into a single row, so the agent’s commentary stands out.


-


**A native diff viewer.** Review your agent’s work like a pull request. Comment on any line or selection. Edit the code right in the diff, which updates as you type. All with proper Swift syntax highlighting and the keyboard shortcuts you know from Xcode.


-


**New color themes.** Light mode is easier on the eyes, with softer accents. Dark mode is more striking, with brighter accents on a near-black background. And we’ve added a Black theme with pure black backgrounds, designed for Apple’s new PROLED XDR displays.


[Bitrig Remote](https://bitrig.com/remote) got the same refresh, so Bitrig feels great on your Mac, iPhone, and iPad.


So update Bitrig and take a look around. I hope you find yourself looking for excuses to use it more, too.
